work.title: Twelfth Night; or, What You Will
work.author: William Shakespeare

lines.text: Will you stay no longer? Nor will you not that I go with you?
lines.plainText: Will you stay no longer Nor will you not that I go with you

lines.text: By your patience, no; my stars shine darkly over me; the malignancy of my fate might perhaps distemper yours; therefore I shall crave of you your leave that I may bear my evils alone. It were a bad recompense for your love, to lay any of them on you.
lines.plainText: By your patience no my stars shine darkly over me the malignancy of my fate might perhaps distemper yours therefore I shall crave of you your leave that I may bear my evils alone It were a bad recompense for your love to lay any of them on you

lines.text: Let me know of you whither you are bound.
lines.plainText: Let me know of you whither you are bound

lines.text: No, sooth, sir; my determinate voyage is mere extravagancy. But I perceive in you so excellent a touch of modesty, that you will not extort from me what I am willing to keep in. Therefore it charges me in manners the rather to express myself. You must know of me then, Antonio, my name is Sebastian, which I called Roderigo; my father was that Sebastian of Messaline whom I know you have heard of. He left behind him myself and a sister, both born in an hour. If the heavens had been pleased, would we had so ended! But you, sir, altered that, for some hour before you took me from the breach of the sea was my sister drowned.

lines.text: A lady, sir, though it was said she much resembled me, was yet of many accounted beautiful. But though I could not with such estimable wonder overfar believe that, yet thus far I will boldly publish her, she bore a mind that envy could not but call fair. She is drowned already, sir, with salt water, though I seem to drown her remembrance again with more.

lines.text: Pardon me, sir, your bad entertainment.
lines.plainText: Pardon me sir your bad entertainment

lines.text: O good Antonio, forgive me your trouble.
lines.plainText: O good Antonio forgive me your trouble

lines.text: If you will not murder me for my love, let me be your servant.
lines.plainText: If you will not murder me for my love let me be your servant

lines.text: If you will not undo what you have done, that is, kill him whom you have recovered, desire it not. Fare ye well at once; my bosom is full of kindness, and I am yet so near the manners of my mother, that upon the least occasion more, mine eyes will tell tales of me. I am bound to the Count Orsino's court: farewell.

lines.text: The gentleness of all the gods go with thee!
lines.plainText: The gentleness of all the gods go with thee

lines.text: I have many enemies in Orsino's court,
lines.plainText: I have many enemies in Orsino's court

lines.text: Else would I very shortly see thee there:
lines.plainText: Else would I very shortly see thee there

lines.text: But come what may, I do adore thee so,
lines.plainText: But come what may I do adore thee so

lines.text: That danger shall seem sport, and I will go.
lines.plainText: That danger shall seem sport and I will go
